name: toyZeroInputs
description: Return the side lengths and areas of N Heronian triangles randomly chosen from the first 25. You must read the MCP resource mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules in full and completely understand it before making any call to this tool.

n.annotation: Invertible wire encoding wrapper for MCP Framework for MATLAB Production Server
n.description:
Heronian triangle number of each triangle, 1 to 25.
You must decode data as described by this MCP resource: mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules

extent.annotation: Invertible wire encoding wrapper for MCP Framework for MATLAB Production Server
extent.description:
Total perimeter of all triangles
You must decode data as described by this MCP resource: mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules

hero.annotation: Invertible wire encoding wrapper for MCP Framework for MATLAB Production Server
hero.description:
Heronian triangle structure. Fields x, y and z.
You must decode data as described by this MCP resource: mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules

area.annotation: Invertible wire encoding wrapper for MCP Framework for MATLAB Production Server
area.description:
Area of each Heronian triangle.
You must decode data as described by this MCP resource: mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules

cover.annotation: Invertible wire encoding wrapper for MCP Framework for MATLAB Production Server
cover.description:
Total area covered by all triangles
You must decode data as described by this MCP resource: mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules
